items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: He told me married a girl who used to play... Yeah, it was Madeline

ctx.x: Tell me, much married. He told me married a girl who used to play. Oh, you used to talk about Madeline. Mm-hmm.
Was she the one who played? Yeah. Yeah, it was Madeline, but the other girls played some too. Yeah, I love it. But these little girls come out and play good. Madeline.
The one with, he told me, married. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, we thought about it. So, uh.
